context: Morning in the Senator's office. Laura is organizing John's schedule.

nodes.text: Good morning, Senator! I've organized your schedule for the week.

moodVariations.Neutral: Good morning, Senator. Schedule is ready.

publicOptions.text: Excellent work, Laura. I don't know what I'd do without you.
You always take such good care of me, Laura.

privateThoughts.text: Her warmth reminds me what I'm missing.

nodes.text: Your schedule is all set, Senator.
